title: Part Ten: How the Shield Works

sections.brief: The mechanism step by step: Genesis 12:3 (ICEJ 'biblical mandate'); the identification of Abram's 'you' with the modern state (Cruz 18 Jun 2025, 'leading defender of Israel', 'nation of Israel'; Johnson Jul 2025; Netanyahu 29 Sep 2025); criticism recast as opposition to God (Jeffress 1 Jan 2017 and 22 Jun 2025; Hagee 6 Jan 2011); the Prejean Boller case (9/11 Feb 2026) with both halves kept together; what the verse says and does not. Figures: flow; compare

Where the shield fails: Christian rebuttals (2007 letter, Mouw, Hunter, Heschmeyer, Kaylor); Cruz's own limit ('I don't use my faith'); Huckabee 20-22 Feb 2026 and walk-back; Bolsonaro 2019 trade office; Kirk's May 2025 letter and the AmericaFest Dec 2025 split (Carlson 'God is not on any country's side'); LifeWay age gap; what is and is not shown. Figures: compare; time
